ZPA Gateway Resource Get ZPA Gateway By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/zpaGateways/:gatewayId

Gets information for a ZPA gateway using the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
gatewayId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the ZPA gateway

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

A unique identifier assigned to the ZPA gateway

name
string

The name of the ZPA gateway

zpaServerGroup
object
zpaAppSegments
object[]
zpaTenantId
int64

The ID of the ZPA tenant where Source IP Anchoring is configured

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the ZPA gateway was last modified

type
string

Indicates whether the ZPA gateway is configured for Zscaler Internet Access (using option ZPA) or Zscaler Cloud Connector (using option ECZPA)

Possible values: [ZPA, ECZPA]

description
string

Additional details about the ZPA gateway
